name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: A 5th-century rock fortress built by King Kashyapa, rising 200 m above the surrounding plains, with ancient water gardens and frescoes at its base.

name: Ella
description: A hill-country village known for hiking trails, tea estates and the Nine Arches Bridge.

name: Galle Fort
description: A Dutch-era fortified town of ramparts, cobbled lanes and colonial houses, built on a headland above the Indian Ocean.

name: Yala National Park
description: Sri Lanka's most famous national park, home to leopards, elephants and more than 200 species of birds.

name: Mirissa Beach
description: A crescent of golden sand popular for swimming, whale watching and the sunset view from Parrot Rock.

name: Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
description: Sri Lanka's most sacred Buddhist shrine, housing a tooth relic of the Buddha on the northern shore of Kandy Lake.

name: Nuwara Eliya
description: A cool highland town at 1,868 m, surrounded by tea estates, waterfalls and the slopes of Pidurutalagala.

name: Arugam Bay
description: A laid-back surf town on the east coast, famous for its long right-hand point break and lagoon safaris.

name: Minneriya National Park
description: The setting for 'The Gathering', where up to 300 elephants come to the Minneriya tank to drink and feed in the dry season.

name: Anuradhapura Ancient City
description: Sri Lanka's first ancient capital, with vast stupas such as Ruwanwelisaya and the sacred Bodhi tree at its centre.
